name: Five Nights at Pingas 7
summary:
Guess who is back? Dr. Ivo Robotnik! Not all endings are what they seem, and even nuclear cataclysm wasn’t enough to cleanse the earth of this underwear-stealing fiend.

It has been 10 years since the release of the first Five Nights at Pingas game, and this seventh instalment is made to celebrate that occasion. Five Nights at Pingas 7 brings back classic meme characters while also incorporating elements of more recent meme culture from the time between the release of Five Nights at Pingas 6 in 2017 and today.
